briefing.headline: Nvidia's board brought Jensen Huang back as CEO, and the AI stock sell-off has pushed chip stocks down sharply this week.

points.text: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO. The stock closed up 31% on that day.
points.label: reported

points.text: President Trump says he intervened in Huang's return. Several commentators call the move a governance mistake or worse.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Nvidia has halted some AI server shipments to South-East Asia.
points.label: reported

points.text: A new US rule tells Nvidia chip buyers to rule out Chinese renters when buying GPUs, according to sources.
points.label: rumour

points.text: Analysts say Nvidia's tech still beats rivals despite the sell-off, and short-term chipmaker earnings should be good.
points.label: opinion
